text:
maria_cs: ACME trial goes live tomorrow AM. Need a one-paragraph customer-facing quickplay + 6 bullets: cache TTLs, cache key example, client batching + tiny JS snippet, streaming fallback, pre-provisioned capacity tip, and renewal-risk signals + tiny feedback card. Keep it short for kickoff. cc @sam_cs @vin_devex

sam_cs: Yup. One-paragraph then 6 bullets max. non-technical.

vin_devex: Paragraph draft: "Recommended quick defaults to keep responses fast and stable: use tenant-scoped cache keys, keep recent completions cached briefly, enable small client-side batching, prefer streaming for chat with a polling fallback, and enable pre-provisioned capacity during initial ramp or demos."

vin_devex: Checklist bullets draft:
1) Cache key pattern: tenant:user:prompt_hash (isolate by tenant).
2) TTLs: completions = 10m; ephemeral session state = 60s.
3) Serve cached immediately and refresh async (stale-while-revalidate) for sub-200ms UX.
4) Client batching: default 3-6 requests/batch; increase for throughput-only flows.
5) Streaming: use SSE/HTTP2; if streaming fails or queue latency >500ms, switch to short-polling.
6) Pre-provisioned capacity: enable for first 72h or during demos to reduce cold starts.

alex_sre: Wording tweak: use "pre-provisioned capacity" for customers. Optional ops notes (don't paste to customer): max inflight/tenant=8, burst token cap, warm pool sizing.

sam_cs: Renewal-risk signals (one-liners for AE): p95 latency >1s -> enable capacity or reduce batch, monthly tokens down >40% -> reach out, 3+ eval failures -> investigate model/rollback, repeated quota saturation -> adjust reserves.

jordan_eng: Tiny JS snippet for kickoff paste:
```js
// simple streaming + polling fallback and batch toggle
window.RW_BATCH_SIZE = 6; window.RW_STREAM = true;
async function generate(payload){
  const res = await fetch('/api/generate?stream=1',{method:'POST',body:JSON.stringify(payload)});
  if (!res.ok) return pollUntilComplete(payload);
  for await (const ch of sseReader(res.body)) processChunk(ch);
}
```

lucy_pm: Feedback card (3 Qs): 1) What were you trying to do? 2) Did the result help? (yes/partly/no) 3) Any short example?
Slack paste: `Hey <name>, 30s ask: could you answer 3 Qs about the trial? [link]`

metrics-bot: Example SQL to detect usage drop:
```sql
SELECT customer_id FROM usage WHERE customer_id='acme' AND current_month_tokens < previous_month_tokens * 0.6;
```

maria_cs: Great. I'll assemble the one-pager and drop into kickoff. Please flag wording within 30m.

alex_sre: No flags. :thumbsup:
